ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the figure “Changes in surface temperature water temperature along a certain latitude in the Pacific Ocean.” <image1> What ocean current deeply affects the sea area b in the figure?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure shows a curve of surface water temperature along a certain latitude in the Pacific Ocean changing with longitude, with the vertical axis being temperature (℃) and the horizontal axis being longitude. Observe the position of the sea area where b is located on the water temperature curve in the figure; it can be seen that the water temperature near b is higher than that of adjacent sea areas at the same latitude, and the curve at that place appears relatively high or raised. Then reason: an abnormally high water temperature in a sea area on the same latitude indicates that this place is subject to a warming effect. According to the nature of ocean currents, warm currents will raise the water temperature of the sea areas they flow through, so the sea area b is deeply affected by a warm current.
